svg.title: SnailNet's main window: the Now page in Streaming mode, where a Steam download uses only spare speed while YouTube, Twitch and a Discord call get all they need

g.text: Steam is using the most right now.
It's using speed nobody else needs. YouTube, Twitch and Discord still get all they need.
